words.def: A book has pages with words and pictures. We read books for fun and to learn.
words.sentence: I read a book about dogs before bed.
words.adultDef: A book is pages with words or pictures, joined together on one side. We read books to learn things and to enjoy stories.

words.def: To cook is to make food hot and ready to eat, like cooking pasta on the stove.
words.sentence: My dad likes to cook pancakes on Sunday.
words.adultDef: To cook means to make food ready to eat by heating it – like frying an egg or baking a cake. A cook is also a person who cooks.

words.def: Your foot is at the bottom of your leg. You stand and walk on it. One foot, two feet!
ask: What things can you do with your foot ?
words.sentence: I kicked the ball with my left foot.
words.adultDef: Your foot is the part of your body at the end of your leg that you stand and walk on. When there are two, we say feet .

words.def: Wood is the hard material that comes from trees. We use it to make tables, fences and campfires.
ask: What things at home are made of wood ?
words.sentence: We need some wood for the campfire.
words.adultDef: Wood is the hard stuff that trees are made of. We use wood to make tables, chairs, fences and pencils. The woods can also mean a small forest.

words.def: Took is the past of take. If you took a biscuit, you picked it up and ate it.
ask: What did you take to school today?
words.sentence: My brother took the last biscuit.
words.adultDef: Took means you picked something up and had it with you, in the past. "Today I take my hat. Yesterday I took my hat."

words.def: Good means nice or well done, like a good dog or a good job.
ask: What is something you are really good at?
words.sentence: Our dog is very good at catching a ball.
words.adultDef: Good means nice, well done or the right way. "That was a good game!" "Good job!" "The cake tastes good."
